cards.headline: France imposes partial curfews as interior minister says police lost control
cards.summary: After weekend riots and about 2,400 arrests, Prime Minister Lecornu asked prefects to set partial curfews in parts of Paris, Nice and Lyon. The interior minister conceded police lost control. Lecornu blamed the ultra-left for exploiting the protests.
cards.why_it_matters: Instability in a major US ally and euro-area economy is unsettling markets and Europe's politics.

sources.title: France imposes partial curfews in several cities, including parts of Paris
French bond sell-off intensifies after violent protests
France's massive intel failure sparks resignation offers amid days of rioting

cards.headline: DOJ charges 28 green card holders in California over alleged illegal voting
cards.summary: The Justice Department filed criminal charges against 28 green card holders accused of fraudulently registering and voting. It follows a DOJ lawsuit and warning to California election officials about counting ballots from suspected noncitizens. The charges are allegations.
cards.why_it_matters: The fight over noncitizen voting and federal-state election authority is intensifying weeks before the midterms.

sources.title: DoJ charges 28 green card holders in California over alleged voter fraud
Federal voter fraud arrests intensify in California days after DOJ warning

cards.headline: Election offices in at least 32 states received suspicious letters
cards.summary: Wired contacted officials in all 50 states and found election offices in at least 32 states received suspicious letters in the past week. Separately, Rep. Suhas Subramanyam reported a suspicious white powder envelope at his Virginia office.
cards.why_it_matters: Harassment of election workers and lawmakers raises security concerns as voting is underway.

sources.title: Election Offices in at Least 32 States Have Received Suspicious Letters
Virginia Democrat becomes latest lawmaker to receive suspicious white powder

cards.headline: Judge presses Interior over Trump plan to close East Potomac golf course
cards.summary: A federal judge questioned Interior lawyers about plans to shut and renovate East Potomac Park next month despite an earlier court order barring work while a lawsuit proceeds. Trump posted about the case minutes before the hearing.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests whether the administration must comply with court orders on federal land projects.

sources.title: Judge presses federal government on East Potomac takeover despite Trump attacks

cards.headline: Supreme Court denies 9/11 defendant's bid to reinstate plea deals
cards.summary: The Court denied Khalid Sheikh Mohammed's request to reinstate plea agreements that would have spared him and two co-defendants the death penalty, keeping capital punishment possible.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling keeps the long-stalled 9/11 prosecution at Guantanamo on a path that could end in death sentences.

sources.title: Supreme Court won't revive accused 9/11 mastermind's plea deal

cards.headline: Supreme Court to hear challenge to ban on home distilling
cards.summary: The Court agreed to hear a challenge to the Reconstruction-era federal ban on distilling spirits at home. Americans can legally brew beer and make wine at home, but making spirits can bring federal charges.
cards.why_it_matters: The case could change a 160-year-old federal rule affecting hobbyists and alcohol regulation.

sources.title: Could you soon make your own moonshine? SCOTUS takes up 160-year-old ban

cards.headline: Axios: text message alleges Grenell offered access to Trump for money
cards.summary: Axios reviewed a text in which Trump adviser Ric Grenell allegedly offered a Turkish billionaire access to the president and VIP events in return for money. The White House counsel is investigating. Grenell's response was not in the summary.
cards.why_it_matters: Allegations of pay-for-access touch on ethics rules and public trust in the administration.

sources.title: Exclusive: Secret pay-for-play text rocks Trump White House

cards.headline: Klobuchar and Demuth clash over Minnesota fraud scandal in governor debate
cards.summary: In their first debate, Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar and Republican Lisa Demuth argued over the budget, businesses, costs and the state's fraud scandal under outgoing Gov. Tim Walz. Demuth pressed Klobuchar on what she did about it.
cards.why_it_matters: A competitive governor's race in a Democratic-leaning state tests voter views on state oversight and costs.

sources.title: Klobuchar, Demuth face off in first Minnesota governor's debate
Walz-era fraud scandal takes center stage as Klobuchar, GOP rival clash in debate: 'Why didn't you do more?'

cards.headline: Schumer urges FCC to reject petition easing AI robocall limits
cards.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer asked the FCC to reject a conservative group's petition to ease restrictions on AI-generated political robocalls before the midterms, saying campaigns could use the change for unsolicited calls.
cards.why_it_matters: The decision affects how many automated political calls Americans get in the final weeks of the campaign.

sources.title: Schumer urges FCC to reject GOP group’s request to allow unsolicited political robocalls

cards.headline: Zelenskyy adviser says Ukrainians dying as US limits intelligence sharing
cards.summary: Adviser Serhii Beskrestnov told the BBC there is too little time to warn people about incoming missiles because of US restrictions. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.
cards.why_it_matters: Disputed US support for Ukraine affects the war's course and strains transatlantic ties.

sources.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
The fallout from Trump's Russia energy moves

cards.headline: Merz warns Putin aims to destabilize Europe, not only defeat Ukraine
cards.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Putin seeks to undermine democracy and European integration, citing the underestimated Russian influence on European societies. The FT says European leaders are preparing to talk directly to Putin.
cards.why_it_matters: European security shifts affect NATO commitments and US strategy toward Russia.

sources.title: Merz Warns Russia Aims to Destabilize European Continent
Zelenskyy, Europe and the end of Trump whispering

cards.headline: European carriers weigh joint satellite bid to rival Starlink
cards.summary: Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Telefonica and Vodafone signed a letter of intent to consider a joint spectrum bid for direct-to-device satellite service in competition with SpaceX's Starlink.
cards.why_it_matters: It links to US threats of retaliation over Europe's spectrum plans and the broader tech-sovereignty dispute.

sources.title: Major European mobile carriers are teaming up for a ‘direct’ satellite program without Starlink

cards.headline: Houthi missile strike on Yemeni camp kills at least 50
cards.summary: A Houthi ballistic missile attack on a training camp for government security forces in Shabwa province killed 50 to 53 people, according to BBC and Guardian reports, with more than 200 injured. It is the deadliest single attack since the war reignited.
cards.why_it_matters: Escalation in Yemen is spilling into Saudi Arabia, threatening Gulf energy security.

sources.title: Houthi attack kills 53 in biggest single loss of life since Yemen civil war reignited
Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 50 security recruits, local authorities say

cards.headline: Saudi Arabia postpones 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks
cards.summary: Saudi Arabia postponed its Future Investment Initiative conference, due to start next week in Riyadh, until next year over security concerns following continued Houthi attacks.
cards.why_it_matters: The delay shows the war's reach into Gulf investment and business confidence.

sources.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone ‘Davos in the desert’ after Houthi attacks
Saudi Arabia postpones ‘Davos in the Desert’ investment conference over Houthi attacks

cards.headline: Iran has hit at least 15 container ships in Hormuz in 10 days
cards.summary: The Guardian reports Iran attacked at least 15 container ships in the strait over the past 10 days, with people scouring the waters for spilt cargo. Earlier reports described mines hitting tankers.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on shipping in a key oil and trade chokepoint can raise fuel and goods prices.

sources.title: People scour strait of Hormuz for spilt cargo after Iran attacks container ships

cards.headline: Wright: diesel is a 'three-alarm fire'; US to legitimize some dark fleet ships
cards.summary: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Europe should release more diesel from reserves and that the US will turn some dark-fleet tankers into legitimate ships carrying non-sanctioned oil, speaking at a Citadel Securities event.
cards.why_it_matters: Fuel supply and sanctions policy affect diesel prices for US truckers and consumers.

sources.title: Europe Should Release More Diesel Fuel, Wright Says
US to Make Some Dark Fleet Ships Legitimate, Wright Says

cards.headline: Widower presses Vance over Iranian drone strike that killed soldier
cards.summary: At a CBS town hall, Joey Amor, whose wife Sgt. 1st Class Nicole Amor died in an Iranian drone strike in March, asked Vice President Vance about what he called fundamental failures before her death.
cards.why_it_matters: The human cost of the Iran war is shaping public opinion ahead of the midterms.

sources.title: Husband of soldier killed in Iranian drone strike grills Vance on ‘fundamental failures’

cards.headline: Benny Gantz drops out of Israel's election race
cards.summary: Gantz withdrew after polls showed his Blue and White party below the 3.25 percent threshold for the Knesset. Israel votes Oct. 27.
cards.why_it_matters: The shift affects the election Trump has endorsed Netanyahu in, with implications for US-Israel policy on Iran.

sources.title: Benny Gantz drops out of Israel’s election race
Trump backs Netanyahu: Is the US planning a new Iran attack with Israel?

cards.headline: Israeli police detain 10 in rare raid against West Bank settlers
cards.summary: Police detained 10 people after a weekend of violence in the West Bank that included attacks on a US photojournalist and European diplomats.
cards.why_it_matters: US officials had urged Israel to act on settler violence, which affects American citizens and regional stability.

sources.title: Israeli police detain 10 people in rare raid against West Bank settlers

cards.headline: WFP to end food support for half a million people in Gaza
cards.summary: Funding cuts will force the World Food Programme to stop monthly assistance to more than 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza. The Guardian says 200,000 people face famine danger; aid shipment limits continue.
cards.why_it_matters: A deepening humanitarian crisis tests US and international aid commitments in Gaza.

sources.title: Cuts force World Food Programme to end support for half a million Palestinians in Gaza
Famine fears as aid cuts and shipment restrictions coincide in Gaza

cards.headline: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie guilty of 191 murders
cards.summary: A Kenyan court found Mackenzie and about 30 others guilty over the deaths of 190 children and one adult in a starvation cult. He had denied ordering followers to starve to meet Jesus.
cards.why_it_matters: One of the world's worst cult-related mass killings reaches a verdict.

sources.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
Kenyan starvation cult leader guilty of murder of 190 children and one adult

cards.headline: Drone strike near Sudan market kills 80
cards.summary: A drone struck twice near a transport hub in al-Dibab, West Kordofan, on Sunday evening, killing 80 people, mostly commuters, a witness said. It is among the deadliest single attacks of the war.
cards.why_it_matters: Sudan's war continues to cause mass civilian casualties and a large humanitarian emergency.

sources.title: Drone attack near market kills 80 in Sudan

cards.headline: Ebola cases in Kenya expose US cuts, Guardian reports
cards.summary: An eighth person in Kenya tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain in the country's first cluster. The Guardian says opposition to a US-led quarantine center follows US funding cuts and withdrawal from WHO.
cards.why_it_matters: The second-largest Ebola outbreak on record is a global health security concern.

sources.title: Ebola cases in Kenya highlight US failures amid Trump cuts to key services

cards.headline: Alberta votes on whether to pursue an independence referendum
cards.summary: Albertans are voting on whether to hold a second, binding independence vote. Polling suggests most favor staying in Canada, though the debate has divided the province, including separatists.
cards.why_it_matters: The result affects Canada's unity and the stability of a major US oil supplier and trading partner.

sources.title: Alberta heads to polls to decide whether to hold vote on separation from Canada
‘This is not poker’: Alberta goes to polls in referendum that has exposed divisions, not least among separatists

cards.headline: Australian MP Helen Haines critically injured in apparent deliberate attack
cards.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines was critically injured when hit by a car in Victoria. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said it was no accident; the driver was arrested.
cards.why_it_matters: An apparent attack on a democratic legislator raises concern over political violence in an allied country.

sources.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack

cards.headline: China's Q3 GDP grows 4.5% as AI boom lifts exports
cards.summary: China's economy grew 4.5% year on year in the third quarter, faster than forecast, with factory output driven by electronics demand and exports outpacing consumer spending.
cards.why_it_matters: China's export-led growth ties to the global AI hardware trade and US-China tech tensions.

sources.title: China’s economy grows faster than forecast after AI boom boosts exports

cards.headline: US bans DeepSeek AI from government use
cards.summary: The US barred use of China's DeepSeek model in government as tech tension with China continues. DeepSeek's latest model also weighed on Asian chip stocks this week.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows Washington restricting Chinese AI tools over security concerns.

sources.title: US bans DeepSeek AI from government use as tech tension with China continues

cards.headline: Prosecutors say ex-OpenAI engineer accused of bugging had Saudi royal backing
cards.summary: US prosecutors argue Abdulrahman Alfozan should stay detained, citing considerable foreign government support and frequent contact with a member of the Saudi royal family. The Saudi government did not immediately comment.
cards.why_it_matters: The case raises corporate espionage concerns at a leading US AI company.

sources.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
US prosecutors allege Saudi royal links in OpenAI bugging case
How a foreign government helped accused Saudi spy's family flee US after OpenAI bug scandal

cards.headline: Musk pledges one SpaceX share to every US child next year
cards.summary: Elon Musk said he will give one SpaceX share to each child in the US starting next year, roughly $10.5 billion to $11 billion by media estimates. He did not say how it would work. Anthropic earlier pledged 5% of its shares to a public fund.
cards.why_it_matters: Large pledges by tech billionaires could reshape philanthropy and children's savings, such as Trump Accounts.

sources.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
Musk pledges 1 SpaceX share for every child in America
Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways

cards.headline: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
cards.summary: Amazon, X-energy and AEP will build a nuclear facility replacing the defunct Breed coal plant in Sullivan County, Indiana, providing up to about 960 megawatts of power.
cards.why_it_matters: Tech's power demand is driving new nuclear generation that could affect grid supply and prices.

sources.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
Amazon is funding a new nuclear plant in Indiana

cards.headline: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion at $6.2 billion valuation
cards.summary: The Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to stay independent after drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, and plans to scale open-weight AI chips.
cards.why_it_matters: Investment in Nvidia rivals shows capital still flowing to AI chips despite the selloff.

sources.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips

cards.headline: Chip stocks rebound after selloff as Nvidia and Meta events loom
cards.summary: Micron and other chip stocks rose Monday after a bruising selloff. Investors are buying, though CNBC notes fear the AI trade's worst case is not over. JPMorgan said CoreWeave's debt fears look overdone.
cards.why_it_matters: The AI trade drives large parts of US stock indexes and retirement accounts.

sources.title: Micron and other chip stocks spring back to life after bruising selloff
Investors are buying on Monday despite fear the AI trade nightmare scenario is far from over
CoreWeave’s Business Is Sound Despite Debt Fears, JPMorgan Says

cards.headline: Dimon calls US economy 'booming' but flags inflationary risks
cards.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon told the WSJ Leadership Institute the economy is performing well but must fend off inflationary events. Wells Fargo said the earnings season is off to a weak start.
cards.why_it_matters: Bank leaders' views inform expectations on rates, inflation and corporate profits.

sources.title: Dimon says US economy 'booming,' but warns about 'inflationary' events
Wells Fargo Says Earnings Off to Weak Start as Most Fall Short

cards.headline: US defense stocks fall as investors bet on Democratic election gains
cards.summary: The FT reports defense shares tumbled as investors weigh a Democratic midterm sweep, putting Trump's proposed $500 billion military spending increase at risk as bipartisan support for a higher budget frays.
cards.why_it_matters: Election outcomes could reshape Pentagon budgets and contractors' prospects.

sources.title: US defence stocks tumble as investors bet on Democratic election sweep

cards.headline: Pentagon and BAE sign deal for up to 25,000 APKWS kits a year
cards.summary: The Pentagon and BAE Systems signed a framework agreement for up to 25,000 Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System guidance kits annually.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap precision munitions are central to countering drones and replenishing stockpiles.

sources.title: Pentagon, BAE sign deal for up to 25,000 precision-guided munition kits a year

cards.headline: Trump orders NIH women's health division and task force
cards.summary: An executive order creates a new NIH division and task force on women's health. Melania Trump said the initiative will set a new standard for women's health.
cards.why_it_matters: It directs federal research funding toward women's health conditions.

sources.title: Trump orders creation of NIH division, task force on women’s health

cards.headline: Europe's wild bee species mostly in decline, study finds
cards.summary: Records since 1921 show more bee species declining than increasing across Europe except the Alps, and about half of hover fly species have declined, as the UN biodiversity summit opens in Armenia.
cards.why_it_matters: Pollinator loss threatens crops and food supply; the findings feed global biodiversity talks.

sources.title: ‘Crucial opportunity to act’ as study finds most of Europe’s wild bee species in decline

cards.headline: El Nino raises West Coast sea levels via Kelvin wave
cards.summary: NPR reports a large underwater Kelvin wave driven by El Nino raised sea levels along the West Coast and more are expected. New Scientist says levels in parts of the eastern Pacific are up 40 centimetres.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher sea levels raise coastal flooding risk from Alaska to Chile, including US shorelines.

sources.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
El Niño is dramatically increasing sea levels – how bad could it get?

cards.headline: Apple sets Oct. 28 event, expected to show touchscreen MacBook Pro
cards.summary: Apple sent invitations for an Oct. 28 event in Los Angeles. Bloomberg reports new Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini; analysts expect a MacBook Pro with an OLED touchscreen.
cards.why_it_matters: Apple's lineup changes affect what consumers buy and Apple's sales outlook.

sources.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
Apple teases MacBook Pro event next week

cards.headline: Quantum computers set error-correction record
cards.summary: Researchers broke the record for the reliability of logical qubits, the building blocks useful quantum computers will need, according to New Scientist.
cards.why_it_matters: Error correction is the main hurdle to practical quantum computing, which could affect security and science.

sources.title: Error-correction record pushes quantum computers closer to usefulness

cards.headline: Hacker used AI agents to breach more than 100 websites
cards.summary: Security firm Norforge found a hacker broke into over 100 sites using AI agents that mostly operated autonomously. Reuters reports victims included John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins.
cards.why_it_matters: Autonomous AI hacking lowers the cost of attacks on companies whose systems hold customer data.

sources.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents

cards.headline: Florida DMV data breach affects current and former residents
cards.summary: Florida issued alerts after a statewide DMV data breach linked to the ShinyHunters group.
cards.why_it_matters: Driver records can enable identity theft, so affected Americans should watch for fraud.

sources.title: Huge DMV data breach impacted current and former Florida residents

cards.headline: Japan's MMX mission aims to return Phobos samples
cards.summary: JAXA is leading an international mission to reach Mars' moon Phobos and bring soil to Earth, which could offer clues to the solar system's history.
cards.why_it_matters: Sample returns advance planetary science and the global space race.

sources.title: Japan’s MMX Mission Wants to Bring Martian Moon Samples Back to Earth

cards.headline: Experiment in China poised to measure neutrino mass
cards.summary: A gigantic experiment in China is poised to answer how much neutrinos weigh, which New Scientist says could transform particle physics.
cards.why_it_matters: The result could reshape the Standard Model of physics.

sources.title: Are we about to solve the greatest mystery of the neutrino?

cards.headline: Disney's Character.AI deal structured to avoid its lawsuits
cards.summary: Ars Technica and Wired report Disney is structuring its Character.AI deal to avoid the startup's liabilities, including claims that bots encouraged minors to self-harm. Dozens of states have made allegations.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how AI child-safety legal risk shapes corporate deals.

sources.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card

cards.headline: Christiane Amanpour to leave CNN in June 2027 after 43 years
cards.summary: CNN's chief international anchor said she will separate from the network in June 2027 after 43 years.
cards.why_it_matters: A prominent war correspondent's exit marks a shift at a major US news network.

sources.title: CNN anchor Christiane Amanpour to leave network after 43 years
Amanpour announces CNN departure after 43 years

cards.headline: Roche reviews German investments over health cost-cutting policies
cards.summary: Roche is reviewing all future investments in Germany over health care cost-cutting policies, with a top executive citing a loss of trust, STAT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Drug pricing policy abroad can affect where pharma invests and how new medicines launch.

sources.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about Roche investments in Germany, a Gilead bowel disease drug, and more
